_note: v2.4 plan 05 T12 live, the foreign-scan-filter Repair (real LLM; so-scenario run <file> --sandbox --group <the sun-ruins group>, twice). test/fixtures/interop/wi-foreign.js splices every 'Xentar Checkpoints' entry out of WORLDINFO_ENTRIES_LOADED (05-H2), which is what a scan-filtering extension does. After TWO loud generations the Repair step must read 'Another extension is hiding this story's lorebook from the model.' naming the book and no extension; after ONE it must not (the predeclared two-generation rule). The splicer is then removed, and one more generation must clear the step. Each generation is one /trigger of one member, so 'one generation' is exactly one: the first live runs used a player send, and in a group one send drafted two members, which is two loud generations (run 2 of 2026-09-25 read hidden after 'one' send, correctly). The first eval removes any earlier run's listeners, and the last step removes the splicer whatever happened.

steps.eval: if (globalThis.__soWiForeign) globalThis.__soWiForeign.off(); const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; for (const key of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((k) => k.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[key]; if (!rt.getSnapshot().requirements.ready) throw new Error(`requirements not ready: ${JSON.stringify(rt.getSnapshot().requirements)}`); if (rt.getSnapshot().loreEvidence?.hiddenBooks?.length) throw new Error('a book already reads hidden before the splicer is installed'); return { ready: true };

steps.send: I look around the guild hall.

steps.eval: const trig = async (name) => { const ev = globalThis.storyOrchestratorLoreEvidence; const before = ev.slotsForChat().length; await SillyTavern.getContext().executeSlashCommandsWithOptions(`/trigger await=true "${name}"`, { handleParserErrors: false }); for (let i = 0; i < 240 && ev.slotsForChat().length <= before; i += 1) await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 500)); return ev.slotsForChat().length - before; }; const added = await trig('Arin'); const snapshot = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot(); if (added !== 1) throw new Error(`expected exactly one loud generation from one /trigger, saw ${added}`); if (globalThis.__soWiForeign.state.spliced < 1) throw new Error('the splicer removed nothing, so the case measures nothing'); if (snapshot.loreEvidence?.hiddenBooks?.length) throw new Error(`reported hidden after ONE generation, below the predeclared two: ${JSON.stringify(snapshot.loreEvidence.hiddenBooks)}`); return { afterOne: 'not yet reported', generations: added, spliced: globalThis.__soWiForeign.state.spliced };
